$comment: Which colours in each traveller body can be re-dyed, and what they are.
A body is a built sheet from `tools/characters.json`; a look is that body with its cloth and
skin re-coloured, so three painted strangers become a road of them without a fourth painting.
See `src/content/looks.ts` for the rule and `docs/strangers-and-happenings.md` for why.
**Chosen by eye, not detected.** Each list was found by lighting one colour of the built sheet
magenta at 6x across every frame and looking -- the rule the character sheets already cost two
wrong heuristics to learn. The sheets are speckled, so a garment is several near-identical
colours rather than one, and every one of them has to be listed or the garment comes out
spotted. Most common first: the first entry is the swatch a face is drawn in.
`test/looks.test.ts` fails if a listed colour is no longer in the sheet -- which is exactly
what rebuilding a body with `npm run build:sprite` would do -- so a stale list cannot quietly
stop dyeing anything. Re-derive by eye when it fires; do not delete the entry.
`face` says which garment a drawn face wears on its head and its shoulders: `cloth`, `second`,
or a painted colour for one that is never dyed -- the drover's turban is cream in every frame,
so a face that dyed it would contradict the figure on the road.
Only traveller bodies are here. The playable five are the player's own face and are never
re-dyed: a stranger wearing a recoloured Varuna is still Varuna.
